narrative:
Belmont County has 42,271 registered voters, with 21.5% unaffiliated or lacking primary history. Republican-leaning voters make up 20.2% of registrants and Democratic-leaning voters account for 50.7%, a pronounced Democratic lean of 30.5 percentage points. Baby Boomers are the largest generational cohort at 31.7% of registrants.
